notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes list Lapwai Days, 208-843-2212, and say she talked with Ruby and sent information May 12, 2026. Gmail shows a direct conversation about pricing/sponsorship and Adventure Zone offered pay-for-play after budget concerns. This is a warm prior conversation, not a cold lead. Source: handwritten call notes, page 84; Adventure Zone Gmail.
